review.notes: All 23 physical pages compared word-by-word against the OCR Markdown; no code fences. Footnotes on pages 1 and 5 and the DeepSeek-R1 author list on page 18 were verified on 300 dpi crops. The printed system-prompt box (Figure 2, p.5) and the appendix chat-style examples (Figures 14-16, p.21-23) exist only inside their embedded figure images in the OCR; the corresponding embedded images were opened and contain the complete printed content, so no text patch is needed for them. Remaining word-level differences are LaTeX math, soft-hyphen line breaks, and infrastructure/ablation figure labels (Figures 3-9).
